# TopoNeural_Mapping

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for translating neural network structures onto physical or logical network topologies, preserving connectivity and communication patterns. Allows direct implementation of neuromorphic models on network infrastructure, reducing latency and energy overhead in distributed systems.
